examples.arabic: انا ببص من الشباك وبحلم احلام حلوة عن الشتا
examples.english: I am looking out the window and dreaming sweet dreams about the winter.
examples.transliteration: Ana babos men el shibbak wa bahlam ahlam helwa an el sheta.

examples.english: The sun is very hot from the window
examples.transliteration: el shams sokhna awy min el shobbak

examples.english: The window is open a little.
I see the rain from the window.
examples.transliteration: ana bashouf el matar men el shibbak

examples.english: I see the rain outside the window.
examples.transliteration: Shayef el matar barra el shobak

examples.arabic: المطر على الشباك عامل صوت كبير
examples.english: The rain on the window is making a big sound.
examples.transliteration: El matar 'ala el shobbaak 'amel soot kabeer.
